title: Dental Implant Osseointegration Following Mandibular Augmentation Using 3D Printed Hydroxyapatite Blocks. An Experimental In Vivo Study
authors: Systermans S, Ronsmans C, Nolens G, Meyns J, Gilon Y, Cobraiville E. Dental Implant Osseointegration Following Mandibular Augmentation Using 3D Printed Hydroxyapatite Blocks. An Experimental In Vivo Study. Clin Oral Implants Res. 2026 Feb;37(2):101-113.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “This is the first study to evaluate a 3D-printed bone substitute in combination with a dental implant in an animal study. Gyroid-3DHA blocks and dental implants demonstrated good osseointegration, and the bone augmentation was significant, making it a promising material for large and complex alveolar ridge augmentations” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
